name: Claude
description: Runs Claude through Anthropic's Agent SDK in its own process, over Studio's agent protocol.
detail: The full Claude agent: sessions held open across turns, sub-agents, background tasks, slash commands, per-tool policy, write confinement, the OS sandbox, model discovery, and Remote Control through claude.ai/code. Authenticates with your local `claude` login, or with an Anthropic API key set on the connection. Downloads around 200MB: the SDK ships its Claude Code CLI as a native binary, and one platform's is fetched.
